# Newmarket Heating & Cooling

> From its base in Newmarket, York Region, Newmarket Heating & Cooling serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (905) 895-4172  |  Email: contact@newmarketheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://newmarketheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Newmarket, Markham, Richmond Hill, Aurora, Vaughan, Keswick, Stouffville, King City
